I have some schooling, but I know this small plot of 0.09 hectare is not worth buying a full bag of chemical fertilizer for — that is too much money for such a small piece. Last season I spread manure here and the harvest was okay, so I will do that again. I will plant the cuttings I saved from last year, and my wife and children will help with weeding and harvesting. We do not need to hire anyone for this small plot, and the rain in this area is enough without irrigation.
